description: This is a C# source file defining the models, repository interfaces and implementation, and the main program to run a web API for managing personal notes. It includes HTTP endpoints for CRUD operations, Swagger API documentation setup, and configuration for CORS and health check.

classes.name: Note
classes.description: A record representing a personal note with ID, title, content, creation and update timestamps.

classes.name: CreateNoteRequest
classes.description: Request model for creating a note, with validation attributes for required and minimum length.

classes.name: UpdateNoteRequest
classes.description: Request model for updating a note, with validation attributes for required and minimum length.

classes.name: INotesRepository
classes.description: Interface defining methods for CRUD operations on notes.

classes.name: InMemoryNotesRepository
classes.description: In-memory implementation of INotesRepository, storing notes in a dictionary.

methods.name: GetAll
methods.description: Retrieves all notes ordered by last updated timestamp.

methods.name: GetById
methods.description: Retrieves a note by its GUID ID.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates a new note with specified title and content.

methods.name: Update
methods.description: Updates an existing note identified by GUID with new title and content.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Deletes a note by its GUID ID.

methods.name: Main
methods.description: Sets up and runs the web API application, configuring services, endpoints, and middleware.
